fields.title: Online Registration
fields.dis: Visit the DTE MP Online portal during the registration window. Register using your 10th standard scorecard details, identity proofs, and personal mobile number.

fields.title: Check Vacant Seats
fields.dis: 1. Visit the counselling portal (e.g., DTE) to see the list of remaining/vacant seats in your preferred colleges.

fields.title: Document Upload & Verification
fields.dis: Upload scanned copies of required certificates (Category, Income, Domicile). The online DTE system automatically verifies most certificates via government servers; manual confirmation is rarely needed.

fields.title: Choice Filling & Locking (Crucial Step)
fields.dis: Log in and select your preferred branch combinations. To secure a seat at our campus, prioritize our code in your allocation grid:
fields.sub_dis: College Choice Priority Code: Govt. Polytechnic College, Harsud

fields.title: Seat Allotment & Merit List
fields.dis: DTE releases round-wise allotment results based on your 10th Merit score/PPT ranking and your choice selections. Download your allotment letter immediately upon release.

fields.title: Reporting & Fee Submission
fields.dis: Physically report to the college campus with your original documents, allotment letter, and the prescribed admission fees to lock and confirm your seat status.

fields.title: Online Registration
fields.dis: Register online for the CLC round on the official portal and pay the required registration fee.

fields.title: Physical Reporting:
fields.dis: Go directly to the college campus on the scheduled date and time with all your Original Documents

fields.title: Merit List
fields.dis: : Submit your attendance at the college counter in the morning. The college will prepare an on-spot merit list of the students present.

fields.title: Seat Allotment:
fields.dis: When your name is called according to your rank, select your preferred available branch and verify your documents.

fields.title: Fee Payment
fields.dis: Pay the admission fee instantly at the college counter to confirm and lock your seat.
